overview:
CA-23 is a Republican-leaning district covering the high desert and mountain communities of San Bernardino County, with a partisan lean of about nine points toward the GOP. Incumbent Jay Obernolte advanced to the general election and holds a decisive financial edge, having raised roughly $1.5 million with $1.6 million on hand. His Democratic challenger, Tessa Lynn Hodge, has raised under $80,000 and had about $10,000 in cash, with negligible outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the picture rests on district fundamentals, fundraising, and prediction markets, which price Obernolte's chances around 94 percent. A Democratic-leaning national environment offers the challenger a somewhat favorable backdrop, but her limited resources make it difficult to compete. The forecast expects Obernolte to win by a comfortable high-single-digit to low-double-digit margin.
